primary.title: AMFI Oct 2026 data: Where is investor money flowing in equity mutual funds? Inflow trends and expert SIP picks for 2027
primary.summary: AMFI’s October 2026 data points to changing investor allocations across equity mutual fund categories, with inflows rising in some segments and declining in others. Experts highlight key trends shaping investor preferences and considerations for those planning fresh SIPs for 2027.
